loginCheck: window.__CONN.loggedIn() — composer present means signed in. A Google sign-in wall => return error login_required.
fallbackFor: Reach this tab when the Gemini CLI is unavailable (registry surface 'gemini' transport (a)). Code should try CLI first, fall back here on CLI error.

default.desc: Standard chat turn (pick the model in the model switcher first if a specific tier is required).
default.activate: Optional: open the model switcher and select e.g. '2.5 Pro' before sending.

deep_research.desc: Gemini Deep Research — multi-step browse + long report. UI-gated.
deep_research.activate: Select 'Deep Research' in the prompt tools, send the question, then click 'Start research' on the generated plan (auto-confirm if command.unattended).

multimodal.desc: Native audio/image understanding (registry routes audio->text and scanned/visual docs here).
multimodal.activate: Attach the file via the upload control, then prompt.

promptSyntax.notes: No system prompt over the UI — frame inline. Gemini Deep Research returns a PLAN first that must be confirmed before it runs; the connector must click through it. One task per turn.

settle.streamingSignal: a stop/cancel control is present means still generating
settle.doneSignal: the send control is re-enabled AND share/export actions appear on the last response

downloads: Files land in the OS Downloads dir; connector returns the name, Code resolves the newest match.
warnings: Gemini uses custom elements (e.g. <message-content>) and aria labels that change; selectors here are best-effort — VERIFY against the live DOM and re-anchor when they break.
verified_2026_06_25: Live-tested OK. composer div.ql-editor confirmed; toolsBtn='Upload & tools', modelPicker='Open mode picker, currently Pro'. insertText worked cleanly (lighter editor than ChatGPT). CAPABILITY LIMIT: the Gemini web app CANNOT create Google Drive folders — its Workspace access only creates Docs/Sheets. A 'create folder tree' request yields a write-up + an Apps Script, not real folders. To materialize a tree, hand off to the Google Drive MCP or run the returned Apps Script.
